fact: 'The solitary one' — a lone orange giant in a wide, empty stretch of sky.
bio: Alphard (Alpha Hydrae) is an orange giant about 180 light-years away, by far the brightest star in the sprawling constellation Hydra, the Water Snake — and conspicuously alone in an otherwise dim region.
cultural: The Arabic name means 'the solitary one', chosen precisely because it has no bright neighbours. That isolation made it a clear and reliable marker in an otherwise faint part of the sky.
